Fight as if your life depends on it, because theirs do.|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave30-3.ogg|[[Lord Exo (Narrator)|Lord Exo]] on Wave 30 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Rift Walker''' was a major boss that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had far higher health than the [[Null Guardian]] and walks far slower than it. As it is a [[Boss]] enemy, most stalls are either weaker on it or do not work on it at all. The '''Rift Walker''' has seven abilities: #''Null Bubbles'', which fires three bubbles at towers. These apply a 25% [[Range Debuff]] to any tower in it. #''Dimensional Shift'', where the '''Rift Walker''' targets four towers, swapping their positions. Additionally, a map-wide 30% [[Range Debuff]] will be applied to every tower, lasting the entire match. #''Null Invasion'', which has the '''Rift Walker''' create rifts to the [[Nil Zone]], summoning in six enemies per each path. These can be the [[Null Engineer]], [[Null Warden]] and [[Null Brawler]]. #''Null Beam'' makes the '''Rift Walker''' fire purple beams at towers and units, stunning them for 3 seconds and dealing 2,000 damage to units. #''Lord Exo Attack'', which makes [[Lord Exo]] come out of the '''Rift Walker''', striking the base and dealing damage equal to 50% of the max base health, accounting for the max possible [[Medic]] overheal but not the [[Skills]] overheal. This can be stopped with the [[Star Cannon]]. #''Ancient Anger'', a rage mode ability activated at 60% health. When activated, the walk animation will change and it will unlock its ''Dimensional Discharge'' ability. #''Dimensional Discharge'' has the '''Rift Walker''' apply a random debuff to every tower on the map. This can be either a [[Range Debuff]], [[Firerate Debuff]] or [[Damage Debuff]], all with a value of 20% and duration of 10. ==Logbook Description== "''The Rift Walker is an{{Sic}} being who helped create the Meta with his master. Together, they maintain the balance of the realms, and will destroy any who threaten it. The Rift Walker is powerful enough to rival greatest enemies from the Old World, and his judgment is absolute. He is known to be strict, for if he fails, everyone from all realities will end up in the Nil Zone.''" ==Appearance== The '''Rift Walker''' has black skin and purple neon eyes. Due to being possessed by [[Lord Exo]], its torso has an exposed grey ribcage. It wears a purple robe and shoes. On its head, it wears a black hat with a purple gem on it. It has a black crow mask with purple bandages wrapped around its beak. It holds a purple and black staff. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Warlock]] are required against the '''Rift Walker'''. **Stun immune towers can be helpful as they cannot get stunned by it, though since a lot of its abilities apply debuffs, they are not completely immune to its attacks. ***[[Temperance]] can be used to give every tower [[Stun Immunity]], the [[Medic]] can also be used to do this to five towers per [[Medic]] placed. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] should be used to boost the statistics of your towers. ***As multiple of its abilities apply debuffs, these can also be helpful at partially mitigating the effects of the debuffs. *The '''Rift Walker's''' ''Lord Exo Attack'' ability deals damage to the base health when finished, meaning that the '''Rift Walker''' can easily kill the players. **This can be stopped with the [[Star Cannon]], as using it during its ability stops the ability entirely. This should be done when the map starts turning yellow and [[Lord Exo]] comes out of the '''Rift Walker's''' body. ***It is highly recommended to wait a few seconds after this happens, so you can stall out the [[Rift Walker]] for as long as possible. **Do note that if [[The Fool]] curse was selected, the base health will be set to 1, meaning any use of it will end the match instantly if the [[Star Cannon]] is not used to stop it. **It is not possible to use the [[Medic]]'s overheal to give yourself the ability to tank more shots, as the ability accounts for that. However, it does not account for the overheal from [[Skills]], meaning that this can be used. ***Because of this, with [[Skills]] overheal, it is entirely possible to avoid building the [[Star Cannon]] in the Easy difficulty, as even by just investing {{Coins|6,245}} total into the Level 13 Over-Heal [[Skills|Skill]], it is possible to tank two more shots than usual. Additionally, the '''Rift Walker''' is much weaker, so you can easily kill it before it deals enough damage to kill your base. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:RiftWalkerLordExo'sRebirth.ogg]] |When the '''Rift Walker''' performs ''Lord Exo Attack'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |{{Color|PhaseTwo|Ancient Anger}} |- |[[File:RiftWalkerAncientAnger.ogg]] |"''You'll bow before my creation, *laugh*. My path leads to corruption, and it's the only way, *growl*. Pain will only remain. Nobody will stand in my way, *grunt*. You puny peons will know me *grunt*.''" |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} RiftWalkerFly.gif|Full Flying animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerFlyLoop.gif|Flying loop animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerBubble.gif|Full ''Null Bubbles'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerBubbleLoop.gif|''Null Bubbles'' loop animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerDimensionalShift.gif|''Dimensional Shift'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerNullInvasion.gif|''Null Invasion'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerNullBeam.gif|''Null Beam'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerExoAttack.gif|Full ''Lord Exo Attack'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerExoAttackLoop.gif|''Lord Exo Attack'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerRage.gif|{{Color|PhaseTwo|Ancient Anger}} animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerRageWalk.gif|{{Color|PhaseTwo|Ancient Anger}} walking animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerDimensionalDischarge.gif|''Dimmensional Discharge'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerDeath.gif|Death animation (31 October 2025 – Present) RiftWalkerLaneSwitch.gif|Unused Lane switch animation {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NightIIIPromo.png|'''Rift Walker''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Null&VoidNightIII24Hour.png|'''Rift Walker''' on the game icon. LordExoImpressed.png|[[Lord Exo]] that possesses the body of '''Rift Walker'''. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Rift Walker''' is the first enemy to be able to freely summon enemies anywhere on the path, specifically through its ''Null Invasion'' ability. *The '''Rift Walker''' has the most base health out of any enemy in the game's history, boasting a massive 2,500,000 health. **If the [[Death]] curse is active, it would reach a total of 5,000,000 health from the [[Bloated]] modifier, surpassing the [[Conserver]]'s previous record of 3,900,100 if not all the [[Super Computer Parts]] were collected. ***Technically, the [[Conserver]] could reach 7,800,200 if it was applied the [[Bloated]] modifier, but this was not possible to do in-game through normal means, unlike the [[Bloated]] '''Rift Walker''' which is possible if the [[Death]] curse is active on the final wave. *The '''Rift Walker's''' design may be based on the [[wp:Plague_doctor|Plague Doctors]]. *The '''Rift Walker''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Rift Walker''' added *'''1 November 2025''' - [[v1.79.0|v1.79.1]] **'''Rift Walker''' no longer becomes immune to damage while performing its ''Lord Exo Attack'' ability. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Rift Walker''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BlindFaith|[[Skeleton]], [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] & [[Null Necromancer]]|Wave 27|Rift Walker|Wave 30|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
